title: Core Modules Knowledge Check
description: Check your understanding of Node.js built-in modules including fs, path, http, events, process, Buffer, URL, crypto, util, and HTTPS.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Which built-in module helps create cross-platform file paths?
questions.explanation: `node:path` provides helpers such as `join`, `resolve`, and `extname` for file paths.
Buffers are used to work with raw binary data, such as file chunks or network payloads.

questions.prompt: Which module should you use for hashing, random bytes, and HMAC operations?
questions.explanation: `node:crypto` provides cryptographic primitives used in security-sensitive Node.js code.

options.text: Publishing named events and registering listeners

questions.explanation: EventEmitter is a core Node pattern for event-driven communication.
